quarterly_data.quarter: Delta Electronics press release: Delta Electronics' Consolidated Sales Revenues for August (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Delta Electronics reported unaudited consolidated sales revenues for August 2026 of NT$64,586 million, a 34.9 percent increase from NT$47,860 million in August 2025 and a 3.7 percent decrease from NT$67,073 million in July 2026. Cumulative January-August 2026 consolidated sales revenues were NT$474,268 million, a 41.1 percent increase from NT$336,211 million in the same period of 2025. August 2026 sales mix: Power Electronics 54%, Infrastructure 34%, Automation 8%, Mobility 4%.
quarterly_data.figure: August 2026 NT$64,586 million (+34.9% YoY, -3.7% MoM); Jan-Aug 2026 NT$474,268 million (+41.1% YoY); Power Electronics 54%, Infrastructure 34%, Automation 8%, Mobility 4%
